summary.flaw: F0-25F.3 causal trace artifact contained 44 rows with only 22 unique event_ids due to globbing both {run_id}.jsonl and causal_stream.jsonl into the same trace.
summary.root_cause: Ingestion loop read all *.jsonl files in runs_dir without filtering to target run_id or deduplicating by event_id.
summary.remedy: telemetry.get_run_events(run_id) strictly targets {run_id}.jsonl and maintains a seen_ids set to deduplicate in-stream entries. Ingestion scripts only query the canonical get_run_events API.
